description: This file contains generated C code for RBUS data element registration, including property handlers, table management functions, and initialization routines for a sample device model.

methods.name: Sample_RegisterRow
methods.description: Registers a row in a specified table and sets its context.

methods.name: Sample_UnregisterRow
methods.description: Unregisters a row from a specified table and removes its context.

methods.name: Sample_Init
methods.description: Initializes the RBUS handle, registers data elements, and sets up context.

methods.name: Sample_Unload
methods.description: Closes the RBUS handle and releases context.

methods.name: registerGeneratedDataElements
methods.description: Registers all data elements (properties and tables) with RBUS.
